text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS141, Starfish Front Door Knocker in Brass

The 4-3/4 Inch Polished Brass Starfish Door Knocker is a stunning example of beach house decor done right. Its classy while still having an easy, free spirited feel that is so iconic of oceanside property. This Polished Brass Standard Starfish Door Knocker is just the right size to make a lasting first impression. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware to install it on a wood or metal door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available: larger 6-1/2" Polished Brass Starfish Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Polished Brass Starfish Standard Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Bronze
  • Height: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 5"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-7/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 2 finishes:
Polished Brass and Bronze Nickel Silver

Sold Individually
